history.description: Added nine scoped PHENOTYPIC graphs with twelve INDIRECT OBSERVED edges and five source ledgers. Verified the OF4 deposited parent sequence and PF01899 mapping; retained B. subtilis historical sequence uncertainty, coupled-assay limitations, T113A abundance/assembly alternatives, P114A tolerance, reused-row numerical differences, T113Y pH dependence and structural-model limits. Original figures and readable table were inspected. Supplements and remaining homolog contexts are explicit gaps; no isolated MrpE chemistry, full-family completion, independent review or publication is claimed.

history.description: Saved the structured PF01899 review for current semantic digest b3abd4ca3fcd6539dc777991398362bf70f848550675f5d068dd920da198e5d0. Nine graphs and twelve indirect observed edges retain exact tested contexts and source-linked limitations. Construct identity, apparent-kinetic versus binding interpretation, T113Y pH dependence, negative substitutions, reused-row discrepancies and structural hypotheses were assessed. The open coverage finding requires supplements, ambiguity resolution and additional homolog research. Native projection validation and the 256-test focused suite passed. This is same-agent partial scientific review, not independent endorsement, promotion to REVIEWED, whole-corpus completion or publication.

causal_graphs.context: LB agar containing 0.2 M NaCl. UOT1285 has trpC2 lys1 aprE-delta3 nprE18 nprR2. The figure's plate duration, temperature and replicate count were not established; membrane-preparation conditions are not substituted.

evidence.explanation: Construction section, Table1 and visually inspected Figure1A establish TY5 identity and its qualitative WT comparison. The separate complementation panel is retained in its own salt/induction context.

edges.mechanism: The TY5 sector lacks comparable growth to WT on the same plate. This supports a salt-growth contribution of the intact gene in this strain, without resolving transport, abundance or assembly intermediates.
edges.subject: delete-mrpe

causal_graphs.family_mapping: B. subtilis reference Q7WY60/BSU31640 is 158 aa with PF01899 at 8-156. Current sequence version2 matches CAE01465.2/YP_054591.2, but differs from historical version1 and was revised in2009. UOT1285/TY5 were not independently sequenced; this is whole-gene, strain-specific evidence, not exact-residue transfer to strain168.
causal_graphs.limitations: Qualitative plate growth, not a measured transport rate. The host retains other Mrp components. Whole-gene loss does not isolate PF01899 chemistry or establish an autonomous MrpE antiporter.

causal_graphs.context: KY11 is TY5 aprE::Pspac-mrpE-His6 spc. LB agar contains 1 M NaCl and 1 mM IPTG; chromosomal integration was PCR-confirmed. The other Mrp genes remain present.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1B delta-E/E-His sector, its caption and Table1 define the complemented strain and distinct assay condition. Association experiments do not supply additional causal edges.

edges.mechanism: KY11 grows under the displayed high-salt induction condition, supporting genetic complementation of the deleted subunit. The edge is conditional on the host's remaining machinery, not autonomous MrpE transport.
edges.subject: complement-mrpe

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q7WY60/BSU31640, PF01899 8-156 of158 aa, is the B. subtilis reference, not a verified sequence of the2007 UOT1285-derived insert. The tag is C-terminal His6; complementation is at aprE, not a scarless native-locus repair.
causal_graphs.limitations: Deletion Figure1A uses0.2 M NaCl, whereas complementation Figure1B uses1 M plus IPTG. Do not calculate a matched-condition rescue magnitude. An empty-aprE vector control and figure-specific replication were not established. MrpE alone is not sufficient outside the remaining Mrp system.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1B supplies the pH series and deletion-versus-parent contrast. Methods specifies reagent concentrations; original Figures2 and4B constrain abundance/complex interpretations.

edges.mechanism: Deleting mrpE strongly lowers the sodium-induced dissipation of the respiratory delta-pH compared with the tagged parent, while retaining a small response. The assay measures whole-complex behavior in host membranes, not direct MrpE ion translocation.

Paper organism Bacillus pseudofirmus OF4, now Alkalihalophilus pseudofirmus. Whole-gene deletion, not an isolated-domain perturbation.
causal_graphs.limitations: A small alkaline-pH response remains. Figure2 retains the other six subunits; a weak Figure4 upper band does not establish an active six-subunit complex. Exact deletion boundaries in the unavailable supplement were not inspected. Both parent and mutant are near baseline at pH6.5, excluded from the decreasing-edge range.

record.description: Subunit of a Na+/H+ Prokaryotic antiporter complex ([[cite:PUB00010583]],[[cite:PUB00010603]]).

evidence.explanation: Figure5 provides the scoped transport/abundance/complex/kinetic endpoints. The antibody peptide discrepancy, unavailable deletion-boundary supplement and intermediate His10 wording need resolution; EF468713.1 verifies the final His7 parent.

Footnoted T113A/P114G reuse differs from2008 values. P114G growth is positive in Table1 despite reduced-resistance prose, and T113Y is not below5% WT at pH9. Preserve the discrepancies and obtain S2-S6.

Two-TM/cytoplasmic MrpE topology supersedes the earlier prediction. L41W retains a dimer peak and salt-growth complementation; its mutant transport kinetics were not displayed. Proposed H131/partner-histidine sodium entry is not an observed binding edge.

The7QRU MrpE sequence differs from the2008 parent at54,62,158. No strong Na/Mg density was found by the authors; competing paths and conformational gating remain models. No raw map reanalysis was performed.

discussions.notes: Retained source assessments are in evidence/PF01899. Measure ion occupancy and transport under matched abundance/assembly conditions before adding molecular edges. Do not replace apparent Km with Kd, turn association into activation, or count reused rows as independent experiments.
discussions.prompt: Resolve construct and numerical discrepancies before assigning a direct MrpE ion-binding or conformational mechanism.
discussions.rationale: T113A changes abundance and complex signals, whereas T113Y and P114G lose much transport despite retained detected complexes. These distinct perturbations do not directly observe sodium occupancy or the proposed E-G-to-A-D activation step. P114A retains function; whole-gene deletion retains a small alkaline-pH response.

evidence.explanation: Strain-level deletion and His6 complementation support growth effects but not exact current-reference residue assignments or isolated-domain function.
S. aureus multisubunit antiporter study is an identified lead, not a completed member-specific causal review.
R. meliloti pH/symbiosis/K-efflux study needs primary-assay and individual-subunit attribution before graph transfer.

discussions.notes: Also review the2003 B. subtilis deletion phenotypes,2009 acidic-residue study,group2/Dietzia homologs and later primary work. The2025 histidine-switch paper was only a search lead. This is partial same-agent curation; status remains IN_PROGRESS and no publication or whole-family completion is claimed.
